title: LLM 0.37.2 fixes API key leak to third-party endpoints
summary: LLM 0.37.2 fixes two security issues, reported by Daniel de Araujo in GHSA-v9h7-jj4g-f862 and GHSA-r639-rr7r-x72w, that could expose a configured OpenAI API key to third-party OpenAI-compatible API providers. The key could be sent if the key named by \`api\_key\_name\` had never been stored, or if a \`responses: true\` model was run with \`-o chat\_completions 1\`. The patch covers the \`extra-openai-models.yaml\` mechanism, now managed by the \`llm openai endpoint add\` command introduced in 0.37.
